name: Aftermath
description: Opens StarCraft replays over the map they were played on: where buildings went down and when, where units were sent, heat maps of the orders across one game or many, build orders, actions per minute and chat, on a timeline that plays back. At scmjs.dev it can also play the game through and show what happened: the units where they stood, what was really built and lost, and each player's army and economy through the game.
author: Jeany
